gloss: waste paper; used paper; recycled paper
notes:
A compound of {古|こ} (old, used) and {紙|し} (paper). Common in environmental and recycling contexts. In Japan, waste paper collection is an important part of the detailed garbage separation system.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {古紙|こし}⟦{回収|かいしゅう}→回収：03019_kaishuu⟧: waste paper collection
- {古紙|こし}⟦リサイクル→リサイクル：04624_risaikuru⟧: paper recycling
- {古紙|こし}{配合率|はいごうりつ}: recycled paper content ratio
- {古紙|こし}100⟦パーセント→パーセント：01537_paasento⟧: 100% recycled paper

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{再生紙|さいせいし}→再生紙：22826_saiseishi⟧: recycled paper — emphasizes that the paper has been reprocessed
- {廃紙|はいし}: waste paper — more formal, emphasizes discarding
